notes: Deposit reconciliation for the finance/rcm/dental pack: Curve deposit detail -> bank credits. Every value is from the owner's samples or the owner-approved generator (tools/dental-synth/gen_dental_set.py group_of, PAYERS, --card-lag-days); 'basis' says which. Lags are bank date minus Curve posting date, in days.

card_processor.basis: observed-in-sample: 65 'GB PY DES:GLOBAL DEP' credits in BANK-ST-JUL-OCT-2024-sample.csv (Phase 4c; the generator writes the same form) + generator: one daily credit, --card-lag-days 1

branch_atm_deposit.basis: observed-in-sample (BKOFAMERICA ATM ... DEPOSIT) + generator: checks and cash of day d deposited on d+1

insurance_eft.basis: observed-in-sample (COMM OF MASS HCCLAIMPMT) + generator: one ACH per payer remittance, posted in Curve the next day; an EFT matches its remittance exactly or is missing, never partial (sweep 2026-11-01: pairing EFT_MISSING with BANK_UNPOSTED was wrong)

methodGroupsBasis: Phase 4c (2026-11-03): American Express, Care Credit and Personal Check are Payment Types in the owner's samples (Per-Sum-Sample-7, BankDep-Det-Sim-Sample-5). American Express and Care Credit -> card_processor: ASSUMPTION from the owner's statement that the Global Payments exports (GLOBAL-*) detail the money in the bank and that no other card or CareCredit credit appears in the bank sample; Personal Check -> branch deposit like Insurance Check: ASSUMPTION (a paper check).

knownCredits.label: bank deposit outside Curve (SB MTOT DEP)
knownCredits.basis: owner 2026-11-03: 'it is a bank deposit'; 4 credits in BANK-ST-JUL-OCT-2024-sample.csv; no Curve method pays into it, so it is listed, never paired or reported as unposted

knownCredits.label: Cherry patient-financing funding
knownCredits.basis: 3 credits 'Cherry DES:Funding' in BANK-ST-JUL-OCT-2024-sample.csv; owner 2026-11-03: the GLOBAL-* exports detail the money in the bank; per-row pairing with GLOBAL-Cherry is the Phase 4c financing trace (not deposit matching)

knownCredits.label: HATCH HCFD ACH payment (source not yet identified)
knownCredits.basis: 2 credits in BANK-ST-JUL-OCT-2024-sample.csv; what it pays is UNVERIFIED (HFD is via Global Payments per the owner, so it is not assumed to be HFD); listed, not paired

actions.UNDEPOSITED_CHECK: find the check in the office and deposit it
actions.CASH_SHORT: recount the day's cash and check who closed the drawer
actions.CARD_BATCH_SHORT: ask Global Payments for the batch detail (fees, chargebacks, voids)
actions.DEPOSIT_SHORT: compare the deposit slip with the day's posted payments
actions.DEPOSIT_MISSING: find the day's deposit; it never arrived
actions.EFT_MISSING: call the payer with the remittance date and amount
actions.POSTED_TWICE: reverse the duplicate posting in Curve
actions.BANK_UNPOSTED: post the payer's remittance to the patients in Curve
actions.DEPOSIT_OVER: find which Curve payments the extra money belongs to and post them
actions.HFD_LAG: watch the funding; chase HFD if it is still missing after 30 days
actions.REF_MISMATCH: correct the check number in Curve
actions.ID_NOT_IN_LEDGER: find why the payment is in the deposit detail but not the ledger
actions.ID_NOT_IN_DEPOSIT: find why the payment is in the ledger but not the deposit detail
actions.LEDGER_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: correct the amount in Curve so the ledger and deposit detail agree
actions.UNMAPPED_METHOD: add the payment method to the reconciliation config

actionsBasis: Phase 4c: one office action per cause code, written by code into the fact sheet a model rewords (owner-approved design 2026-11-03); wording is a default the owner may edit. Avoid the words bank, account, routing, sort: next to a number the gateway masks it as a bank account (test/facts.test.ts checks this).

diagnose.basis: method names from the owner's samples (BankDep-Det Payment Type); HFD = Healthcare Finance Direct via Global Payments (owner); late-funding window is a flag-like assumption

evidence.basis: owner-approved 2026-11-01 21:02 (Phase 4b-3, decision A): sign = bank minus Curve; negative = money missing from the bank, positive = extra money in the bank, neutral = no bank difference (HFD_LAG is a watch item: below Curve inside the lag window). BANK_UNPOSTED detail is a raw bank description, which can hold a person's name, so it is never put in evidence (decision B).
